note: Winter. The 2020 model gave Q1 2050 h and its peak block 130 h, 2180 h together, that is 90.8 days: December-January-February.
Spring. 1464 h in the 2020 model, exactly 61 days: March-April.
Early summer, the irrigation release: the reservoirs open for the fields downstream and the hydro runs whether the load calls for it or not. May-June.
Late summer, the cooling peak: here it is the load that is high, and it is the season the Pakistani deficit falls in. July-August-September.
Autumn. 1464 h in the 2020 model, exactly 61 days: October-November.
